reason: A macOS-focused DSH plugin that monitors session activity and provides Dock badge and local sound notifications for completed or attention-required results.

summaries.zh: 在 macOS 上通过 Dock 角标和本地提示音提醒用户 DSH 会话运行、完成或需要处理的状态。
summaries.en: Provides macOS Dock badges and local sound alerts for DSH sessions that are running, completed, or require attention.

capabilities: Displays macOS Dock badges for running sessions and unread results
Plays a local sound when sessions complete or require attention
Tracks session read and unread state while the application is unfocused
Provides user settings for badges, activity indicators, and sound alerts
